quests.title: Good Hunter Express

dialogue.sit: Hmm, I've got other things to do right now.

dialogue.t: Really? Okay then. I'll find someone else to make that delivery...
Oh, yes, this Mondstadt Hash Brown is just out of the oven, so do handle it with care.
Don't run too fast, don't use your wind glider, and don't get into a fight, or that hash brown may just come apart.
You do have to be quick, though. This dish won't taste good if it gets cold.

dialogue.section: Deliver the food to Hardworking Silio

dialogue.t: Ugh, I'm starving... Why hasn't my order arrived yet?

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogue.t: That's correct. You're here to help, right? Then you're right on time — I'd just finished making this Mondstadt Hash Brown.
It's supposed to go to Silio. He paid us earlier, and said that he'd be waiting for his delivery near Stormbearer Point.
Thanks for delivering this hash brown to me.

quests.description: The Good Hunter has a special order that needs sending out...
